WITH cur AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.home_store_id, m.join_date FROM dim_member m WHERE m.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' AND m.is_current
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name,
       COUNT(*) AS members_current_home, COUNT(a.member_id) AS active_52w,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_id) AS dist_members, MAX(c.join_date) AS max_join
FROM cur c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = c.home_store_id AND s.is_current
LEFT JOIN active a ON a.member_id = c.member_id
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND fs.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT 'Tampere' AS city, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = cur.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
